name: com.saltcrate/oracle
title: SaltCrate Oracle — web search, page monitor, link checker, CVE & dependency scanner
description: Search, extract, verify claims, monitor pages, check links & npm/PyPI/CVE deps over MCP. No key.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get clean, readable text from a web page — boilerplate, navigation, and ads stripped — so you can work with the actual content. Returns the text plus title, content-type, HTTP status, and length.

tools.name: check_link
tools.description: Is this URL live right now? Returns HTTP status, the redirect chain, final URL, and round-trip latency in milliseconds.

tools.name: check_change
tools.description: Did this web page change since the last time it was checked? Hash-based change detection. First check reports 'new'; later checks report 'changed' or 'unchanged'.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Does this source URL support a given claim? Returns a confidence score, matched terms, and the best supporting excerpt. Heuristic term-overlap — not semantic fact-checking.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Schema-driven structured extraction: fetch a URL and map its content into typed entities that conform to a JSON Schema you provide. Pass the schema as a JSON string; returns schema-conforming JSON (e.g. pricing, company facts, product specs, events). Requires DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Live web search. Returns a list of {title, url, snippet} results plus which backend served them (free DuckDuckGo by default, or Brave/Serper when configured).

tools.name: monitor
tools.description: Watch a URL over time — call periodically and pay per check. First call reports 'new'; later calls report 'changed' or 'unchanged', with changes_since_first_seen, first_seen, and last_checked timestamps for recurring monitoring.

tools.name: check_deps
tools.description: Is this dependency current, and does the version in use have known vulnerabilities? Takes a package name and returns the latest version, deprecation/license, and advisories from OSV.dev with the version that fixes each. Accepts 'lodash@4.17.20' (npm-style), 'requests==2.19.0' (PyPI-style), or a prefix: npm:, pypi:, cargo:, go:, gem:. Backed by the live registries — no guessing.
